name: vision-arena-bench-multiple-images
description:
Multi-image dataset with multiple images per row, synthesized from lmarena-ai/vision-arena-bench-v0.1, which has 1 image per row. 
Each row has the same image 10x. 'content' in each row is prefixed with 'Consider only the first image provided. '
reputation: Derivative, small-scale dataset built on Vision Arena; limited adoption beyond exploratory robustness tests.
